parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: The excerpt contains no reported Adjusted EBITDA figures for any period. The only number is forward-looking guidance: full-year 2025 subsidiary Adjusted EBITDA of $335 million to $355 million, excluding Lugano Holding, Inc. That is a forecast range, not a reported result, so it is excluded. The reconciliation schedules the release refers to are not included in the excerpt.
